_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::input_format#25 — the TYPE of a DESIGN ... NEUMANN CONDITION is validated twice with two different vocabularies. The input parser's deprecated_selection accepts Dead|Live|PressureGrad|orthopressure|pseudo_orthopressure, but the 3D SOLID element (src/solid_3D_ele/4C_solid_3D_ele_surface_evaluate.cpp) implements only Live, orthopressure and pseudo_orthopressure. Consequence: TYPE 'Dead' passes the parser and then aborts at the first element evaluation with 'Unknown type of SurfaceNeumann condition' — the input file looks perfectly valid, which is what makes it a trap. A value outside the parser enum fails earlier and helpfully prints the whole enum. Three runs: Live -> 'Finalised step 1 / 1', exit 0; Dead -> exit 1 at evaluate; Follower -> exit 1 at parse with the enum listing. Verified by execution 2026-08-03 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf).
